name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-product-packaging
title: Pink-to-blue halftone banner with a 'product packaging' folder and tool icons
whatItIs: A wide banner with a red-pink to violet to blue halftone gradient, a manila folder titled 'product packaging' in serif, a pixel cursor, a white scribble burst and Photoshop, Figma, spark and Illustrator icons.
whatItMeans: Colourful and nostalgic; the vivid halftone makes a simple label feel like a poster.
techniques: Use a multi-colour gradient under halftone dots.
Keep the folder composition constant across a series.
Add a white scribble burst behind the folder.
Surround with app icons for skill hints.

vocabulary.definition: A category name on a folder.
A layout reused with a changed label.
